736820101.text: I have waited so long for you, my brave friends! Seize this awesome opportunity! Explore the art of adventure with me! Try to surpass yourself!

736820104.text: Paimon doesn't completely understand what you're saying, but it sure sounds impressive! Care to explain?

736820105.text: Of course... Hold on, I know you... It's you!

736820106.text: The hero who fought Stormterror in the skies, the ever-dutiful commission shredder, the finder of hidden chests, the breacher of the unknown mists...

736820107.text: With you leading the charge, everyone will surely be fired up for this great event!

736820109.text: Paimon's never heard of them before!

736820110.text: Such titles are usually coined around drinks, campfires, and for children's bedtime stories. They are only passed on by word of mouth, so it's normal for you to not have heard of them.

736820111.text: Anyway, your presence encourages many adventurers, giving them the motivation to keep getting stronger!

736820112.text: #So {NICKNAME} has become this famous in the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild already? How about Paimon? Does Paimon have any titles?

736820113.text: Ahem! I think I heard a friend mention that some call you... "The Great Paimon, light as a bird's feather, and as unfettered as the north wind itself."

736820114.text: "Light as a bird's feather" describes your small and agile body, while "unfettered as the north wind" refers to your appetite, which is on par with a Knight of Boreas!
